posts.description: On a clear day, the picturesque Mount Rainier serves as an impressive backdrop for our beautiful Kent Valley patch and corn maze. Throughout the farm, you’ll encounter a sea of pumpkins, challenging corn mazes, kids activities, and plenty of photo inspiration. No pets, firearms or smoking/vaping, please. -Meet the farm animals -Play in the kids area -Take a hayride -Race rubber ducks -Practice your roping … and so much more! Plan to bring the whole family for a day full of fun! Patch and corn maze: 27508 W. Valley Hwy N., Kent . Farm Fun Yard: 6720 S 277th St., Kent .

posts.headline: 星期日亲子精选
highlights: 农场秋日嘉年华亲子同乐：抚摸动物、桶式小火车、脸部彩绘、巨型泡泡、橡胶/成人斧头投掷等活动一票畅玩。儿童票含喂动物饲料包，现场还可加购自选南瓜与花束，并参与宝石淘矿募款活动。
posts.description: Fall is just around the corner, and that means it’s time for our favorite tradition of the year! Join us at The Red Barn Farm in Redmond, WA for our 8th Annual Fall Festival, a family-friendly celebration full of autumn charm, exciting activities, and memories waiting to be made. When: Every October weekend: Saturdays & Sundays! Where: 5703 208th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98053 Duration: 3 Hours | Last entry at 3:00 PM (activities end at 4 PM) Ticket Pricing Adults: $12 Children (Ages 1–17): $20 (includes 1 feed bag to feed the animals!) Infants (Under 1): Free Add-Ons U-Pick Flowers: $25-35 (includes vase + fill it with flowers of your choice) U-Pick Pumpkins: Traditional varieties at $0.58/lb | Specialty varieties at $0.89/lb Extra Feed Bags: can be purchased on site with all proceeds donated to our non-profit Gem Mining: This year, our nonprofit is excited to host a gem mining fundraiser! Discover crystals, shark teeth, fossils, gems, and more at this activity booth! Tickets (in the form of donations) will be available for purchase on-site. S’mores What’s Included Your ticket includes access to all our favorite fall activities: Face Painting Adult Axe Throwing (Ages 13+) & Rubber Axe Throwing for kids Barrel Train Rides Petting Zoo Animal Feed Bags Chicken Poop Bingo Rubber Duck Races at Playground Giant Bubble Station Cow Roping (practice, not real!) Fall Crafts in the Barn Mini

posts.description: October only- Halloween costumes (especially farm themed) encouraged! Lots of fall photo opportunities await! This is the only place in the Pacific Northwest where you can pet, feed, and connect with Scottish Highland cows, yaks, reindeer, alpacas, mini donkeys, and horses—all in one unforgettable visit. And yes, our adorable baby calves can’t wait to meet you! More than just a tour, this is your chance to slow down in nature, savor the moment, and create heartwarming memories with majestic animals. Perfect for all ages! Image sourced from event website.

posts.description: Circle round and get ready to be transported into a world of color and adventure—Storytime in the Store is back during October’s Family Day! At 11 AM and 1 PM, settle into the Beacon Gallery where a local children’s book author will read from a selection of their stories. The tales will be lively and engaging for the whole family! Books from the reading will be available in the BIMA Store and you can even get signed copies after each reading. Come and join the fun!

posts.title: Seabrook Halloweekend
posts.headline: 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 🎟️ 活动免费参加。🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。
posts.description: Start the day at Barn Hill Park from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM with fall activities for the whole family. Make your way through the Hay Bale Maze, pick out a pumpkin from the Pumpkin Patch, and settle in for pumpkin carving and painting. Festive music and warm seasonal beverages add to the autumn atmosphere. Then grab your costumes and join the Halloweekend Costume Parade! Starting on Market Street at 3:00 PM, families, kids, and leashed pets are invited to dress up and show off their Halloween looks as the parade makes its way through Seabrook. After the parade, keep the costumes on and candy buckets ready for Trick-or-Treating around town. Participating Seabrook merchants will be handing out sweets and treats to continue the Halloween fun. Image sourced from event website.

roundup.title: 本周末亲子活动精选｜8城8场
roundup.caption:
这个周末，8 个城市都有适合家庭的活动！🌿

本周亮点包括「Giant Skulls Day of the Dead Art Exhibit」和「Carpinito Brothers Fall Festival」，适合安排轻松又充实的亲子时光。从户外探索到社区活动，各个城市都有值得带孩子一起体验的选择。

我们整理了 8 场地区亮点：

- Seattle：Giant Skulls Day of the Dead Art Exhibit
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：Westlake Park · 401 Pine St., Seattle, WA 98101
  亮点：🎟️ 活动免费参加。

- Kent：Carpinito Brothers Fall Festival
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：Carpinito Brothers Farm · S. 277th and West Valley Highway, Kent, WA 98032
  亮点：晴天可望雷尼尔山作背景，在南瓜海与挑战性玉米迷宫里尽情打卡。

- Bellevue：Halloween on the Hill
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：South Bellevue Community Center · 14509 SE Newport Way, Bellevue, WA 98006-1514
  亮点：适合所有年龄的万圣节活动日。

- Redmond：Red Barn Farm Fall Festival
  日期：Sunday, Oct. 25
  地点：The Red Barn Farm · 5703 208th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98053
  亮点：农场秋日嘉年华亲子同乐：抚摸动物、桶式小火车、脸部彩绘、巨型泡泡、橡胶/成人斧头投掷等活动一票畅玩。

- Lake Stevens：A Very Farmy Halloween Edition
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：Luckie Farms · 930 Sunnyside Blvd, Lake Stevens, WA 98258
  亮点：近距离喂食高地牛、驯鹿、牦牛、羊驼、马和迷你驴，还能穿万圣节装扮拍照。

- Olympia：Lattin’s Fall Festival
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：Lattin’s Country Cider Mill and Farm · 9402 Rich Rd SE, Olympia, WA 98501-9558
  亮点：南瓜田采摘、充气城堡、小游戏，还有可爱的农场动物相伴。

- Bainbridge Island：BIMA Storytime in the Store
  日期：Sunday, Oct. 25
  地点：Bainbridge Island Museum of Art · 100 Ravine Lane N.E., Bainbridge Island, WA 98110
  亮点：🎟️ 活动免费参加。

- Seabrook：Seabrook Halloweekend
  日期：Saturday, Oct. 24
  地点：Seabrook, Washington · 4275 SR 109, Seabrook, WA 98571
  亮点：🎟️ 活动免费参加。

收藏这份周末清单，带上家人一起出门玩吧！
